text: The ___ Theorem guarantees that every real symmetric matrix has an orthonormal basis of eigenvectors and only real eigenvalues.
explanation: The real Spectral Theorem states a symmetric matrix is orthogonally diagonalizable: A = Q Lambda Q^T with Q orthogonal and Lambda real diagonal. It underlies principal-axis decompositions and the Sturm-Liouville eigenfunction expansions met later in the course.
